title: MOTION (PARK - BLUMENFIELD) relative to coordinating a street banner campaign to promote the Del Rey Neighborhood Council and encourage participation.
text:
[Council File 26-1679; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (PARK - BLUMENFIELD) relative to coordinating a street banner campaign to promote the Del Rey Neighborhood Council and encourage participation.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. APPROVE, in accordance with Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) Section 62.132, the Street Banner program being coordinated by the Del Rey Neighborhood Council, as a City of Los Angeles Non-Event Street Banner Program for the period of January 1, 2027 to January 1, 2028.
2. APPROVE the content of the attached street banner design.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
